plugins.name: Armory
plugins.summary: Farm Armory stars and maintain passes with configurable game rotations.
plugins.overview: Armory rotates selected accounts through games that award pass XP. It can maintain passes in live mode and gives users a separate shop for spending credits.
plugins.integration: Shares its account and game plan with Games. Tracks busy accounts and yields to waiting Trader routes after in-flight work finishes.

plugins.name: Games
plugins.summary: Work toward game reward tiers or contribute XP to Armory passes.
plugins.overview: Games models the expected token cost of reaching the next reward tier and tracks bets, rewards and net results. The XP mode targets Armory progress. Actual results can vary.
plugins.integration: Uses routed requests for some games and sockets for crash and blackjack. Reads the Armory plan and avoids accounts being seated in battles.

plugins.name: Missions
plugins.summary: Claim completed missions and show progress on clicking accounts.
plugins.overview: Missions polls each healthy account, claims eligible mission rewards, and displays progress in a Missions tab and account-card badges.
plugins.integration: Uses staggered per-account scheduling and clears the cached account view when a run stops.

plugins.name: Monthly pass
plugins.summary: Claim monthly pass rewards from the free track, Pro track or both.
plugins.overview: Monthly pass checks selected clicking accounts on an interval and claims eligible tiers for the configured track.
plugins.integration: Uses the host account selector and a separate claiming switch. The Pass tab reports each account’s progress.

plugins.name: Rewards
plugins.summary: Claim ready rewards for rank, clicks, vault progress and other milestones.
plugins.overview: Rewards checks selected clicking accounts and claims redeemable reward-chain tiers. Its tab reports progress and recent results.
plugins.integration: Uses the same routed request and per-account scheduling APIs as the farmer’s other claimers.

plugins.name: Converter
plugins.summary: Turn inventory and capsules into tokens through configurable steps.
plugins.overview: Converter can sell cases and eligible skins, buy and open capsules, and optionally use accumulated tokens for Dragon Lore upgrades. Individual stages have their own controls.
plugins.integration: Uses cash and price limits, previews in Practice, and publishes which accounts are assigned to its upgrade step so Armory can skip them.

plugins.name: Opener
plugins.summary: Preview and open cases, capsules or collections across selected accounts.
plugins.overview: Opener can buy stock within a budget or use existing stock. It can handle drops, favourite rules and boosting effects. It tracks account XP and rank changes.
plugins.integration: Uses account busy markers during turns. The inspected beta also supports a Discord webhook for favourited drops when configured by the user.

plugins.name: Trader
plugins.summary: Move items and tokens between accounts using one-off trades or saved routes.
plugins.overview: Trader coordinates sender and receiver sockets. Both accounts must be in ZSB Hub and clicking. The plugin supports a practice mode and receipt checks.
plugins.integration: Serializes work per sender and receiver, and uses handoff requests when Armory is using an account needed for a route.

plugins.name: Effects
plugins.summary: Buy, sell, activate and queue special effects on selected accounts.
plugins.overview: Effects manages quantities and ammo reserves. A queue waits for the current effect in a family to finish, then activates the next configured effect.
plugins.integration: Uses account-scoped inventory and effect state. This version was present in the inspected beta and absent from the signed catalog snapshot.

plugins.name: Proxy manager
plugins.summary: Configure and test proxy or WireGuard routes for the farmer.
plugins.overview: Proxy manager publishes routes to the core, checks reachability and lets the user pin accounts to a route.
plugins.integration: Uses the host’s routing API and secret storage. WireGuard uses a local SOCKS bridge. Routes with a shared known exit IP share their capacity.

plugins.name: Account Pulse
plugins.summary: See which accounts are healthy, need attention or are stopped at a glance.
plugins.overview: Account Pulse is a read-only dashboard for account health. It lists the accounts known to the farmer and can hide stopped accounts from the table.
plugins.integration: Reads the cached account list and registers a settings toggle, tab, table and summary action. This plugin makes zero site requests.
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh
